entries.topic: Board: orphaned claims, keeper corrections and cost, richer tasks, history, blockers, auto-dispatch
entries.result: Built the owner's picks (items 1-6, 9, 10 of ten): Stop hook, release on exit/delete, stale marks and a visible orphan box; not-a-task / wrong-title feeding eval:keeper --reported; keeper pause and read counter; notes, images, done links, history with an archive; blocked-by; opt-in per-project auto-dispatch with guards. Tests: store, board, routes, real tmux, hooks incl. Stop, MCP tools (previously untested), browser. Owner-chosen but left out: side panel view, idle-with-queue alert. Known limits in docs/design-todos.md §19.

entries.topic: Board: tests for the gaps found by use
entries.result: Added real-tmux tests (send next, refusal of working/shell panes, typed answers), the hook scripts run for real, a Chromium test of the board page (incl. the hidden-task regression), an env preload so the suite passes from the service's shell, and npm run eval:keeper (21 labelled tails; 63/63 now, 61/63 on the previous prompt). Keeper accuracy on real threads still unmeasured beyond this. Also fixed the flaky 'upgrades' tests (two assertions assumed which chat is newest; a delayed save from an earlier test made them fail 1 run in 5 under the full suite): 8/8 full runs green.

entries.topic: Board: an answer must reach the session that asked
entries.result: Owner found that replying to a question did not reach the tmux session: the answer was saved but the hook fetched only open items, and chats were prompted only when idle. Now an idle tmux asker gets the answer typed in, GET /todos carries the last 24 h of answered questions, and the hook prints the ones addressed to its own session first. Verified end to end with a throwaway tmux session (typed answer acted on in 2 s) and a test for the chat path.

entries.topic: Board: sessions as containers in In progress, a Done board per session
entries.result: Owner corrected the per-session-columns reading: keep the kanban, but In progress holds every session as a container (task card or empty slot), and a second board below, Done, has one column per session; the sessions strip stays as a multi-select filter with a tmux-only switch, remembered per device.

entries.topic: Board keeper: Haiku reads each thread and moves the cards
entries.result: The heuristic recorder put a paused conversation in done with the previous reply as result; owner caught it. Replaced by a Haiku 5.5 read per thread (summary, title, status working/done/needs_you/idle, result, question) that the server turns into done items and owner questions, deduplicated per session, forced right after a chat's turn end, 10 s tick for tmux. Accuracy on real threads not yet measured.

entries.topic: Board: inline approvals and filters, after a look at the field
entries.result: Owner asked for inspiration from tools that do this. Surveyed Kanban Code, Anthropic's Agent View, claude-code-kanban, Vibe Kanban, Conductor (docs/design-todos.md §14). Adopted: open approval cards shown on the Needs-you card with Allow/Deny that resume the chat (POST /board/decide), and filtering the kanban by project tag or session pill. Not adopted: a Review column, worktree per task.

Fourth layout in a day. The lanes were rejected outright; asked to choose, the owner picked a classic kanban: Queue · In progress · Needs you · Done across all projects, cards tagged by project with the session as a name and state dot, a sessions strip above as the drop target for assigning. Finished turns are recorded in done (first sentence of the reply as result; duplicates skipped). Mockup and live page built from the same files.

entries.topic: Board redesign: thread insight and three columns
entries.result: Owner asked via the board's own queue (first item sent to a session, taken by tmux:modchanger). Session cards now carry a one-line Haiku 5.5 summary (cached, refreshed when the transcript changes, max every 90 s), exact working/idle read from the tmux pane's spinner or done line (measured on three live panes), model and context %, and the queue is to do / in progress / done. Verified live on dev with a headless render; src/insight.ts + 6 tests. Same day: busy sessions without a board item appear in the in-progress column with their prompt; the last prompt and last words are read from the pane with tool chrome filtered out; summaries persist in workspace/.insights.json across restarts; a theme switch on the page.

Built into codeTerminal, not a mod: todo.json per project root (server sole writer, gitignored globally), /board.html across projects with sessions busy/idle and the queue, a For-you section where chats file questions via todos.ask, send-next to idle chats, MCP tools + a UserPromptSubmit hook and status-line fragment for terminal sessions. Verified on dev 2026-10-09: 676 tests (5 pre-existing failures unrelated), live board lists 3 projects, hook and status line print the queue. Design: docs/design-todos.md.

entries.topic: Board: send next to a tmux session
entries.result: Built 2026-10-09: the board types the item into an idle tmux session (send-keys -l + Enter, pane must read idle), claimed as tmux:<name>. Measured on a throwaway session: one prompt, reply in 2 s. Owner asked the same day.
